title: BrainBench Cat 35 Transcript-Distill Receipt
description: Receipt contract for Cat 35 (Transcript → Brain-Page Distillation Fidelity). The chart generator, the published report, and the E1 regression-delta path all consume this shape. additionalProperties stays true at the top level for forward compatibility (e.g. judge_calibration, lane_errors, prior_run_skipped_reason).

mode.description: Only mode=full receipts (whole corpus, all lanes, no subset flags) may feed the published benchmark page; partial = CAT35_FULL with narrowing flags (never publication-eligible); b-pre-validity is the safe-by-default smoke.

gbrain_sha.description: The pinned gbrain commit the run executed against (package.json pin).

corpus_sha.description: SHA256 over the corpus manifest — pins every benchmark input file.

judge_model.description: The REQUESTED judge model id. May be a movable alias (the 2026-08 published runs recorded claude-sonnet-4-6); see judge_models_resolved for server-reported evidence of what actually ran.

judge_models_resolved.description: Optional (receipts written before 2026-09-01 predate it): map of server-reported model id (resp.model) to judge-call count for this run. The key 'null' counts responses that carried no model field. Best-available evidence, not an immutability proof. Cross-run deltas require both receipts to carry exactly one identical real model key.

comparability.description: Optional: delta eligibility vs the prior receipt actually found. 'comparable' requires mode/lanes/corpus/corpus_sha/transcript-set equality AND a single identical resolved judge model on both sides (judge_models_resolved). 'non-comparable' means deltas were suppressed. Omitted on first runs (no prior receipt).

config_snapshot.description: Models, thresholds, max_turns — everything needed to check E1 comparability.

joint.description: Per-item joint score (coverage credit × mechanical evidence verification). Dream lane only; null elsewhere.

coverage_by_lane.description: Per lane: macro (headline — mean of per-transcript recall), micro, strict (FULL-only), partial_rate, and the seeded transcript-level bootstrap CI.

coverage_by_notability.description: Descriptive breakdown: notability tier → lane → recall.

coverage_by_depth.description: Descriptive breakdown: depth bucket (early/middle/late) → lane → recall.

verbatim_quote_fidelity.description: Mechanical quote fidelity over dream-page blockquotes + qualifying inline spans, checked against the transcript.

hallucination.description: Per lane (facts + dream): claim counts and 1 − claim precision over verifiable claims.

distractor_leakage.description: Per lane: mechanical anchor hits and judge-confirmed surfaced-as-salient leaks. Separate axis from hallucination — distractor content is true-but-noise.

rate.description: null when no page-producing lane emitted anything (usability is conditional on emission).

emission.description: Selectivity axis: expected-high transcripts that produced ≥1 dream page. Pure-routine silence is correct and never pollutes usability.

compression_ratio_by_lane.description: Output tokens ÷ transcript tokens per lane, chars/4 approximation on both sides.

violated.description: null = not evaluable (lane error or judge failure).

separation.description: Score distributions per expected group (high vs low). Descriptive separation check, not calibration.

prior_run.description: E1 regression baseline actually used (null on first run or comparability mismatch).

deltas.description: Headline metric deltas vs prior_run. Informational only — nothing gates on a delta.

item_flips.description: Per-item status flips vs the prior run (e.g. FULL→ABSENT) — the actionable regression signal.

gates.description: Validity gates (verbatim coverage, judge_failed rate, dream emission). Values may be null when a gate is not applicable to the lane set.

transcripts.description: Transcript ids evaluated in this run (the chart reads its length).

signal_transcripts.description: Count of evaluated transcripts carrying gold items — the coverage-macro denominator population (headline n). Optional: receipts written before 2026-08-26 predate it.

usability_by_lane.description: Per-lane usability (verbatim and dream are incompatible populations; the blended usability.rate alone misleads).

cost_note.description: What total_cost_usd covers. Judges + facts only: the gbrain phase API does not surface dream-lane subagent spend.
